bootstrap.transport_mode: manifest-first exact same-path Git blob binding

candidate.mechanism: Before a repository effect, durably checkpoint a stable effect identity plus predecessor/current-blob authority. On an explicit GitHub REST 403/429 rate-limit response, perform no same-run wait or retry. A later scheduled invocation reboots current authority, inspects target/effect identity first, and either recognizes the already-materialized effect or retries the same logical effect under current-blob CAS. The protocol never treats API rate capacity as hosted compute and never depends on Actions, Codespaces, artifacts, LFS, packages, cloud credits, Work, protected-primary execution, or manual user execution.
candidate.tested_scope: GitHub REST repository/Contents transport under explicit primary or secondary rate-limit responses only; no intentional quota exhaustion, no ambiguous network-ack loss, no same-run wait/poll/backoff/retry, no protected O mutation, no scheduler mutation, no second semantic leaf.

primary_source_evidence.source: GitHub Docs: Rate limits for the REST API
primary_source_evidence.fact: Primary exhaustion returns 403 or 429 with x-ratelimit-remaining=0 and requests should not be retried until x-ratelimit-reset. Secondary exhaustion also returns 403 or 429; retry-after or reset guidance applies, and continued requests while limited may lead to banning.

primary_source_evidence.source: GitHub Docs: Best practices for using the REST API
primary_source_evidence.fact: Rate-limit errors should stop further requests until Retry-After/reset guidance permits retry.

comparison.exact_identity_reason: The only reliability step added by this candidate is moving an already-required checkpoint+stable-effect-identity+verify-before-retry+CAS pattern across a later recurrence when a transport window is rate-limited. Current Phase-1 control already requires lightweight repository transport to tolerate per-window rate limiting through cross-invocation checkpoint/resume, and the immediately preceding role-local state explicitly carries this protocol as the next refinement of the same GitHub Contents transport family. Therefore it is not an exact-distinct dependency-elimination mechanism.
comparison.o_comparison: NOT_RUN because exact-family duplicate classification resolves this bounded leaf without consuming O semantics; no novelty or decision-relevance judgment is fed to CLEAN exploration.

hard_gates.ordinary_per_window_rest_rate_limit: present but permitted only as resumable repository transport; not treated as an accepted finite monthly/trial/paid hosted quota
hard_gates.zero_quota_scope: No optional hosted compute/storage quota is required by the protocol. Repository transport availability itself remains subject to per-window API rate limiting and must resume only in a later invocation.

candidate.exact_continuation: Fresh-bootstrap current manifest/lifecycle/root/downstream authority, then execute exactly one bounded comparator leaf on GITHUB-CONTENTS-AMBIGUOUS-COMMIT-ACK-LOSS-RECONCILIATION-v1. Test the harder case where a repository mutation may have committed but the response/ack is unavailable: determine whether immutable effect identity plus target readback and current-blob CAS can distinguish committed-vs-not-committed before any retry, preventing duplicate logical effects without same-run waiting, Work/protected-primary/manual execution, finite monthly/trial/paid quota, or added cost. If exact-family duplicate, persist duplicate classification and one nonempty next continuation only; do not start a second leaf.
